question: How much is a landing page with Rafizaweb?
answer: From Rp300,000 with the Small Business package, including hosting and a .my.id or .web.id domain for the first year. You get 1 landing page from a template of your choice, registered with Google so people can find it when they search your business name, a WhatsApp button, social media, and Google Maps, 1 design revision, and 14 days of warranty and support. Delivery takes 2–3 working days, and renewal is Rp300,000/year. You provide the materials (logo, photos, and text), and registering the domain requires the business owner’s ID card (KTP).
